pre_recon_estimate.rationale: 24 次严格上限；四个基线侦察调用后，一个两 hunter 波与一个 quick 最终 critic；预留约 30% 后续余额（6 次）给候选 Phase 3/5 独立复核。超出预留的候选按 fingerprint 顺序验证，不足则 incomplete。

dynamic_validation.validation: 只在完整 OS 沙箱可用时用隔离 fixtures 与 dummy Docker CLI/daemon 验证；部署事实由 owner 只读取证
dynamic_validation.status: 仅当猎取形成具体候选后登记
dynamic_validation.risk: 任何依赖 Docker CLI/daemon 实际效果、宿主机文件系统/权限/符号链接行为或部署代理/Origin 配置的结论

execution_plan.scope_reason: 本批覆盖 Compose 删除新增的宿主机文件删除、配置保留、部分失败恢复与资源版本不变量；其他后续提交仍 pending/out_of_scope。
stop_conditions: 不执行 KPanel 测试、构建、浏览器、目标代码或真实 Docker
预算或墙钟到限即保留已验证证据、标记未完成单元并准确写 incomplete
只有源码无法决定的 Docker/OS/部署事实可成为 needs_validation，需列具体缺失事实与最小验证计划

actual_cost.tokens_reason: 平台不提供可靠 token 计量
actual_cost.wall_seconds_definition: Elapsed start to the audit parent stopping its failed bounded documentation closeout; includes post-cutoff shutdown/closeout, not 2143 seconds of coverage work.
actual_cost.accounting_reason: Complete invocation accounting was not serialized; observed completed responses establish only a lower bound of seven distinct child agents. Planned counts must not be used as actual counts.

interruption_reason: Audit wall budget exhausted; platform agent thread limit prevented coverage critic. A bounded documentation closeout then failed before writing artifacts and stopped. No completed coverage is claimed.
disclosure_policy: PROJECT_RULES.md 5.4: publish summary metadata; retain detailed candidate and independent verification transcript privately. No coverage ledger was produced, no completed coverage or clean conclusion is claimed.
